shortDescription: Manage Splunk Enterprise Security response plans

options.name: api_app
options.description: The app portion of the Splunk API path for the response templates endpoint. Override this if your environment uses a different app name.

options.name: api_namespace
options.description: The namespace portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different namespace.

options.name: api_user
options.description: The user portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment requires a different user context.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the response plan.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the response plan. This is the unique identifier and is always required. Used to look up existing response plans for update or delete operations.

options.name: phases
options.description: List of phases in the response plan. Required when C(state=present). Phases are matched by name for updates. B(Note:) Only phases defined here will exist after update. Any existing phases not included in this list will be removed from the response plan.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the response plan. Use C(present) to create or update the response plan. Use C(absent) to delete the response plan.

options.name: template_status
options.description: The status of the response plan template. Use C(draft) for work-in-progress plans. Use C(published) for plans ready for use.
